# RankAgent

> An SEO agency in your pocket. RankAgent runs the full audit a human SEO agency would — technical health, on-page setup, structured data, content, Core Web Vitals and AI/GEO visibility — then gives you the exact, plain-English fix for every issue and helps you apply it with AI. Same results, a fraction of the cost.

RankAgent is a global AI-powered SEO + GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) tool with India-attractive pricing. It serves two audiences: small SEO agencies/freelancers (white-label client reports, portfolio, prospect audits) and small business owners (a self-serve plan to fix their own site).

## Free tools

- [Free SEO Scorecard](https://therankagent.com/): Audit any website in ~30 seconds — score, grade, and the issues costing you customers. No signup.
- [SEO audit results](https://therankagent.com/seo-audit/): Shareable per-domain SEO report cards.
- [All free tools](https://therankagent.com/tools): Nine free, no-login SEO & AI tools for freelancers and small agencies.
- [Interactive SEO Checklist](https://therankagent.com/tools/seo-checklist): A saveable 90+ point SEO checklist across indexing, on-page, content, local, links, speed and AI visibility.
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://therankagent.com/tools/ai-visibility-checker): See whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI assistants mention your brand — and what they say.
- [llms.txt Generator & Validator](https://therankagent.com/tools/llms-txt-generator): Create or check the llms.txt file that tells AI crawlers how to read your site.
- [Schema (JSON-LD) Generator](https://therankagent.com/tools/schema-generator): Build valid structured-data markup so Google and AI engines understand your business.
- [Cold-Pitch Email Generator](https://therankagent.com/tools/cold-email-generator): Turn any prospect's site into a ready-to-send pitch email led by a real SEO finding.
- [AI Share-of-Voice Matrix](https://therankagent.com/tools/ai-share-of-voice): See who AI assistants name in your space — you vs your competitors.
- [Perplexity Citation Finder](https://therankagent.com/tools/citation-finder): Find the questions where Perplexity already cites a site — you or someone else.
- [AI Crawler Status Checker](https://therankagent.com/tools/ai-crawler-checker): Check whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended are allowed to read a site.
- [Entity Gap Analyzer](https://therankagent.com/tools/entity-gap-analyzer): Spot the topics and entities a page is missing versus what AI expects.

## Guides

- [SEO by industry](https://therankagent.com/seo-for): Plain-English SEO guides for e-commerce, lawyers, real estate, dentists, doctors, restaurants and gyms.
- [SEO by platform](https://therankagent.com/platform-seo): SEO guides for WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, WooCommerce and GoDaddy.
- [Blog](https://therankagent.com/blog): Jargon-free SEO, local SEO, AI/GEO and comparison guides.
